className={classNames(\n      'flex items-center size-full',\n      label && 'gap-1 min-w-0',\n      isRightAligned && 'justify-end',\n      !label && !isRightAligned && 'justify-center',\n    )}\n ...compareRunIndexHeaderDef(run.index),\n    flex: 1,\n    minWidth: EXTRACTED_COLUMN_MIN_WIDTH,\n    ...NO_FILTER_COL_DEF,\n    valueGetter: (params) => {\n      const result = params.data && ...pairCellClassRules(context, getStatusPairKind),\n});\n\n/**\n * An index column is a pair of per-run columns here, so a field the merged rows never vary is expanded\n * to every run's colId — the With the number hidden, that span collapses to the 1px\n  // border, so the bucket color never fills the row.\n  .ag-cell > .dial-kit-dropdown {\n    align-items: stretch;\n\n    > span {\n      display: flex;\n      height: 100%;\n      min-height: 0;\n    }\n  }\n\n  .ag-body-horizontal-scroll {\n    min-height: 12px;\n  }\n}\n\n// GridView wraps the grid in height: 100%. Targeted tests (311), both typechecks and lint pass. I couldn't check it in a browser because the Playwright server failed to connect, and I haven't run the full `npm run test` suite.\n\n**What was wrong**\n- **Mixed letter case and size:** the column labels in one header row used three different styles. Some fell back to the grid library's default (tiny, uppercase, letter-spaced). Some used the ellipsis header but inherited that uppercase at a larger size. \"Total requests\" replaced the whole header, which also dropped the sort and menu controls.\n- **Group labels in two weights:** \"Execution\", \"Extracted\" and \"INPUT BINDINGS\" used the library default, while the metric groups used a lighter custom header.\n- **Score labels on the left:** whether a metric label was right-aligned depended on the first value found for it. If that value was empty, or every cell was a dash, the label (e.g. SCORE, EXACT_MATCH) sat at the left while its values sat at the right.\n- **Uneven spacing on the compare grid:** its group row was 28px high while the other header rows are 40px.\n\n**What changed**\n- **Same label style everywhere:** `EllipsisHeader` now turns off the inherited uppercase and letter spacing. `EllipsisHeaderGroup` now uses the same semibold style as the column labels.\n- **Run results grid (`Runs/View/utils.ts`):**\n  - Every column label now goes through the shared ellipsis header, right-aligned for numeric columns.\n  - \"Total requests\" keeps the standard header, so sorting is back.\n  - All groups use the shared group header, and \"INPUT BINDINGS\" is now \"Input bindings\".\n  - Metric alignment now looks at the first non-empty value.
